Package de.eldoria.eldoutilities.debug.data.chart

Class SeriesChart

java.lang.Object
de.eldoria.eldoutilities.debug.data.chart.ChartData<SeriesChart>
de.eldoria.eldoutilities.debug.data.chart.AxisChart<SeriesChart>
de.eldoria.eldoutilities.debug.data.chart.SeriesChart
public final class SeriesChart extends AxisChart<SeriesChart>
A line, area or bar chart of one or more series. The values of a series are placed by their position; a null value leaves a gap.
